'''Malin''' (Japanese: '''マリン''' ''Malin'') is a minor supporting character who appeared in ''[[M15|Kyurem VS. The Sword of Justice]]''.

She is an enthusiastic girl who {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} met during their travels en route to [[Roshan City]]. Malin was a little taken aback by {{an|Cilan}}'s enthusiasm, but appreciated the group's business. She sells {{p|Darumaka}} {{wp|bentou|boxed lunches}}, which can be turned into wind chimes, and "{{b|Oran}} Ice" on the [[Windy Station]] platform with her Pokémon {{p|Vanillite}}. The business was marked in the travel guide that Cilan was reading on the train. Malin waved Ash and his friends goodbye as their train departed.
